engineering_hard_failure_rule: invalid sample blocks that arm and no replacement request is automatic
blinding_rule: opaque sample IDs; mapping inaccessible to evaluators until judgment freeze
evaluator_independence_rule: two fresh independent evaluator contexts; a third only as prospectively authorized tie breaker
review_method: setwise within each dimension, with paired task identity but shuffled sample order
variance_handling: high dispersion or evaluator disagreement yields INCONCLUSIVE, never an inferred pass
non_inferiority_rule: zero critical B regressions and minimum support on every critical dimension; no scalar compensation
generalization_limits: character-heavy only; does not authorize other demand classes or production cutover
